name: St Hubert with St Wulstan, Great Harwood

boundary.description: From junction of Blackburn Old Road and Wilpshire Road, N along Wiplshire Road, York Road to and E along Ribble Valley – Hyndburn District boundary bend on Shawcliffe Lane near Hill Side, then by a beeline to and SE along River Calder crossing A680 Whalley Road, to its confluence with Hyndburn Brook, and SW along the that brook to the point opposite Barons Way, then W by Norden Brook, Lee Lane, N by Wilpshire Road to its junction with Blackburn Old Road.
